description:
Soothing Music | Veena for Tired Mind | 1.5 Hours

If your brain feels like an open browser with 47 tabs — start here. Veena's gentle plucked harmonics literally close the tabs. Just listen.

90 minutes of slow veena music, played to help your mind soften and settle after a long day.

🎵 What you'll hear:
- Veena — an ancient Indian string instrument with a deep, resonant sound (think slowed-down sitar with more depth)
- Long sustained notes with natural pauses between phrases
- A gentle healing frequency layer to help the nervous system release
- Unbroken sound — no abrupt fades, no startling moments

⏱ Chapters
0:00   Settling — softening into the chair
12:00  Tabs closing — first quiet space
35:00  Mental clarity returning
60:00  Restful spaciousness
80:00  Gentle return

🧠 How to use:
Press play. Stop trying to think your way out of the tiredness. Let the slow strings do the work. Tea optional. Phone away.

⏱ Best for:
• Mental exhaustion / decision fatigue
• Inability to switch off after work
• End-of-day cognitive overload
• Pre-sleep wind-down
• Long restful background sessions

📺 Subscribe to Raga Focus for daily uploads:
- Sitar, Sarangi, Veena, Surbahar, Bansuri, Tanpura and other Indian instruments
- Music for anxiety, overthinking, sleep, stress, emotional release

— Raga Focus
